verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an account-level suppression list, or any API to read, add, or remove suppressed bounce, complaint, or unsubscribe addresses. Bounce and complaint notifications via SNS and event publishing are adjacent building blocks for a list the user would build themselves, not product-managed suppression. The axis clearly applies to an email-sending service, so the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can read and manage bounce, complaint, and unsubscribe suppression lists via the API so my app never re-emails a hard bounce
